title: Taking your responsibility in Mirror Trading International one step further
description: Using your referral link and other business building tips. Join the official MTI Members News Channel on Telegram ...

asr.full_text: Taking your responsibility in Mirror Trading International one step further If you are giving out your referral link, this means you intend to build a team. Therefore your referrals are your responsibility When someone joins using you referral link, it is your duty to follow up with that person. If they have joined and funded their account, welcome them to your business and ask them if they would like to be included into the WhatsApp group so they can get regular updates. Tell them about the video channel and ask them if they need assistance with anything. If they have joined and not yet funded their account, ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin and if necessary provide them with information to help them get started with Bitcoin. Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need. Remember to tell them about the video channel so they can get more information. I have people in my team who I don't know. What should I do? Congratulations, Your social media viral marketing campaign is obviously working! To get the details of these people go to Direct Referrals and click on See Detailed Report. You will see a list of all the people who have joined using your referral link and you will find their email addresses listed and their mobile number. In some cases you may need to go back to your team genealogy tree and click on their icon to see which country they are from and then try to figure out what the international number would be. Welcome them, and follow the steps mentioned earlier in this video. Furthermore, you can guide them in building a team of their own, and this can often be done in conjunction with your sponsor. Remember, this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom. For more information please contact the person who sent you this video.

textual.observation: The speaker links distributing a referral link and building a team with a claimed path to financial freedom.

evidence.quote: If you are giving out your referral link, this means you intend to build a team.
build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom.

textual.context: Presented as instructional business-building guidance; whether the financial outcome is guaranteed or independently supported is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised financial outcome is tied to distributing a referral link and recruiting or building a team.
textual.limitations: No return amount, timeframe, guarantee, fees, or evidence of actual earnings is established.

textual.observation: The speaker instructs team members to help recruits start with Bitcoin and fund their accounts.

evidence.quote: If they have joined and not yet funded their account, ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin
Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need.

textual.context: Presented as assistance for referred participants within the described business-building process.
textual.potential_relevance: Recruitment is paired with guidance to use Bitcoin and fund an account, creating a concrete payment or transfer step linked to the opportunity.
textual.limitations: No wallet address, payment recipient, amount, fee, authorization, or outcome is provided.

textual.observation: The speaker tells members to retrieve referred people's email addresses and mobile numbers and contact them.

evidence.quote: you will find their email addresses listed and their mobile number.
Welcome them, and follow the steps mentioned earlier in this video.

textual.context: Presented as follow-up outreach to people who joined through a referral link.
textual.potential_relevance: Recruitment is linked to accessing listed contact details and initiating outreach to referred people.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish consent, data source, identity accuracy, or any misuse of the contact information.

textual.observation: The description directs viewers to join a claimed official MTI Members News Channel on Telegram.

evidence.quote: Join the official MTI Members News Channel on Telegram

textual.context: The description presents the channel as official; its authenticity and the nature of the destination are not independently established.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed official affiliation is linked to a request to join an external Telegram channel.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the channel's ownership, authenticity, or what occurs after joining.

visual.observation: The presentation is labeled "NETWORKERS ONLY" and states "Taking your responsibility one step further" alongside the Mirror Trading International branding; later screens show "Direct Referrals 4," personally referred members, and a referral/binary genealogy tree.
visual.context: The slides present the material as a business-networking or member-referral program. The sampled frames do not show spoken explanation of the referral requirements or any explicit payment amount.
visual.potential_relevance: A business-growth presentation is visibly connected to recruiting or tracking referrals, which may merit review as a recruitment-linked opportunity claim.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether recruitment is required for participation, whether referrals generate compensation, or whether any users paid or received money.

visual.observation: A slide titled "Business Success" displays a luxury car and yacht, and a later slide instructs viewers, "Please contact the person who sent you this video."
visual.context: The luxury-asset imagery appears in a branded promotional presentation, while the contact instruction directs the viewer to the sender rather than naming a public destination.
visual.potential_relevance: The business-success imagery is paired with a request to contact the referring sender, creating a visible connection between an implied success outcome and a personal follow-up action.
visual.limitations: The frames do not state that the car or yacht can be earned, identify an owner, specify eligibility or returns, or show what happens after contacting the sender.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source frames the content as referral and business-building guidance and directs viewers to the sender for more information.

evidence.quote: Using your referral link and other business building tips.
For more information please contact the person who sent you this video.

visual_context_notes.observation: The opening slide visibly includes a yellow-and-black "WARNING" box stating, "THIS VIDEO WILL HELP YOU GROW YOUR BUSINESS," with Mirror Trading International branding.
The presentation includes tutorial and dashboard imagery covering Bitcoin, Bitcoin withdrawal, video tutorials, direct referrals, and member/team details.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International as a business opportunity, instructs viewers to recruit referrals, help them fund accounts with Bitcoin, and build teams. It presents team growth as a path to “financial freedom” and directs viewers to contact the sender for further participation, establishing a concrete recruitment and money-flow solicitation rather than reporting or criticism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted opportunity connects a referral link and branching team-building structure to a stated financial-freedom outcome. The source does not specify a commission rate or demonstrate earnings.
